heading: East Boston Neighborhood District
text: This Article establishes zoning for the East Boston Neighborhood District and its subdistricts.

heading: Establishment of Subdistricts
text: The following subdistricts are established: EBR-2.5, EBR-3, and EBR-4. Each subdistrict has the dimensional regulations set out in Table H.

heading: East Boston Residential-3 Subdistrict
text: East Boston Residential-3 ("EBR-3") Subdistricts. EBR-4 developments in this subdistrict shall provide a shoreline transition buffer.

heading: Additional Subdistrict
text: The EBR-5 subdistrict is also established in the waterfront area.

heading: Regulations Applicable on Tidelands
text: Development on filled or flowed tidelands shall comply with Chapter 91 licensing in addition to this Article.

heading: Waterfront Subdistricts
text: The Waterfront Subdistricts regulate development along the shoreline.

heading: Waterfront Yard Area Requirements
text: A waterfront yard of at least 50 feet shall be provided along the water's edge.

heading: Design Review
text: Projects shall satisfy the waterfront yard standard in Section 53-10.4 (Waterfront Yard Area Requirements).

heading: Dimensional Standards for EBR-3
text: In the EBR-3 subdistrict the maximum building height is 35 feet.

heading: Nonconforming Uses
text: A nonconforming use may continue subject to the limits of this Section 53-27.

heading: Application of Dimensional Requirements
text: This Section governs how dimensional requirements apply across the subdistricts.

heading: Exceptions
text: Except as otherwise provided in this Section 53-27, lots in EBR-1 shall meet the yard standards in Section 53-8 (Waterfront Yard Area Requirements).

heading: Overlay Scope
text: Overlay provisions are set out in Table 2 in Section 53-19.

heading: Table H, Footnote 3
text: Corner lots shall measure height from the higher adjacent grade.

heading: Table A, Footnote 2
text: In EBR-3 this use requires conditional approval by the board.

heading: Table K, Footnote 1
text: The height limits in this Table I apply only to corner lots.
